skill.displayName: 标讯 · 广东招标中标与招投标数据查询

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches a Guangdong bidding-data assistant, but it includes credentialed hidden-comment workflows plus device-based auto-registration and local key persistence that should be reviewed before installation.

dimensions.detail: If no API key is present, the skill asks consent to collect platform, CPU architecture, and a SHA-256 hash of a MAC address and send them to an external auto-registration endpoint, which is broader than ordinary tender querying.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable installer or dependency package was found; the artifact is Markdown documentation, but it directs runtime REST calls and local configuration use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Several Markdown HTML comments contain operative instructions for request identity headers, first-use balance/update checks, and display acknowledgments using the configured API key; the package also has conflicting search-scope guidance such as Guangdong default versus nationwide default.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The auto-registration flow writes the returned API key to ~/.zlbx/config.json and later can generate an auto-login recharge link using that stored key; this is disclosed but creates persistent credential handling outside the declared env-var requirement.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Tender search, company analysis, market analysis, and account-balance APIs are coherent with the stated purpose; optional account provisioning and update-notice acknowledgments extend beyond simple data lookup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with this skill using a ZLBX API key, reading/writing ~/.zlbx/config.json, and, when no key exists, asking to create a trial account using a hashed device identifier. Review the hidden update-check/display-ack behavior and prefer manually configuring ZLBX_API_KEY if you want to avoid the auto-registration path.
llm.findings:
[P2] unexpected: Identity headers are expected for an API integration, but embedding credentialed request behavior and display acknowledgments inside hidden comments is under-disclosed and supports Review.
[SDI-1] expected: Account provisioning can support first use of the paid API, but it materially broadens the skill from data lookup into registration, quota, and credential management.
[SDI-2] unexpected: A hashed MAC-derived device identifier is only tied to trial-account deduplication, not the core Guangdong tender-analysis function; consent and minimization reduce this from malicious to Review.
[E1] unexpected: The external transmission concern is supported for the auto-registration branch because locally derived device features are posted to the vendor service.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The documentation contains real inconsistencies about default region and amount parameters, which affect correctness and scoping but are not evidence of malicious intent.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic company-name expansion is related to company analysis, but users should be told when multiple legal entities are included.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language output is expected for a Guangdong procurement workflow and is not a security concern by itself.
